data.standardized_narrative: The report's balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at the prior-year comparative (31 December 2017) as approximately GBP 100.655m. The document does not present a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure that could be reliably extracted from the provided images; therefore a quantified prior-year development (gross) cannot be determined from the accessible pages. Segmental premium totals show gross premiums written for 2018 of GBP 100.064m.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images were provided as rotated scans with limited OCR. I was able to read the balance sheet gross 'Claims outstanding' totals and the gross premiums total, but I could not find a clearly labelled GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) in the accessible pages or the movement note was not legible. The segmental/regulatory premium breakdown (by class) and the detailed claims development triangle appear in the report but could not be reliably parsed from the images; therefore the premium mix and per-LOB prior-year movements are omitted. Opening reserves taken from balance sheet prior-year comparative column (31 Dec 2017) = 100,655 (units: GBP 000 -> 100.655m). If you can provide higher-resolution or upright full-page images (especially of the Technical Provisions note and the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note), I can extract the missing prior-year development and the premium mix precisely. Note: some pages indicate a claims development table exists (triangle) but its numeric cells were not reliably OCR'd for extraction.
